meta.author: self
meta.note: 全部自撰，不复制任何真题原文

items.zh: 近年来，中国经济保持平稳增长，居民收入不断提高。
items.reference: China's economy has maintained steady growth in recent years, and the income of residents has been rising continuously.
hints: 得分点：近年来 / 平稳增长 / 居民收入 / 不断提高
「平稳增长」用 steady growth；「居民」可用 resident；两个分句都用现在完成时
句型：China's economy has maintained … in recent years, and the income of residents has been rising …

items.zh: 电子商务的快速发展改变了人们的购物方式，也带动物流业的繁荣。
items.reference: Thanks to its rapid development, e-commerce has changed people's way of shopping and also promoted the prosperity of the logistics industry.
hints: 得分点：快速发展 / 电子商务 / 购物方式 / ……的繁荣
「电子商务」可用 e-commerce；「繁荣」是 prosperity；「物流业」是 the logistics industry
句型：Thanks to its rapid development, e-commerce has changed … and also promoted …

items.zh: 中国政府大力推进乡村振兴，农村基础设施明显改善。
items.reference: The Chinese government has vigorously promoted rural revitalization, and rural infrastructure has been significantly improved.
hints: 得分点：大力推进 / 乡村振兴 / 农村基础设施 / 明显改善
「大力推进」可用 vigorously promote；「基础设施」是 infrastructure；后半句用被动语态
句型：The Chinese government has vigorously promoted …, and rural infrastructure has been significantly improved.

items.zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，越来越多的农村人口迁入城市。
items.reference: More and more rural residents have moved into cities with the acceleration of urbanization.
hints: 得分点：随着……的加快 / 城市化 / 农村人口 / 迁入城市
「城市化」是 urbanization；「迁入」可用 move into；「越来越多」可用 more and more
句型：More and more rural residents have moved into cities with the acceleration of …

items.zh: 中国的制造业正从低端加工向高端智能制造转型。
items.reference: China's manufacturing industry is transforming from low-end processing to high-end intelligent manufacturing.
hints: 得分点：制造业 / 从……转型 / 低端加工 / 智能制造
「转型」用 transform from … to …；「低端／高端」用 low-end／high-end
句型：China's manufacturing industry is transforming from … to …

items.zh: 移动支付的普及让中国人出门几乎不需要带现金。
items.reference: Thanks to its popularity, mobile payment has made it almost unnecessary for Chinese people to carry cash when going out.
hints: 得分点：普及 / 移动支付 / 不需要 / 带现金
「普及」是 popularity；「让某人做某事不必」可用 make it unnecessary for sb. to do
句型：Thanks to its popularity, mobile payment has made it almost unnecessary for … to carry cash when …

items.zh: 中国与许多国家加强合作，共同推进基础设施建设和贸易往来。
items.reference: China has strengthened cooperation with many countries to jointly promote infrastructure construction and trade.
hints: 得分点：加强与……的合作 / 共同推进 / 基础设施建设 / 贸易往来
「加强合作」用 strengthen cooperation with；「共同」可用 jointly，用不定式表目的
句型：China has strengthened cooperation with … to jointly promote …

items.zh: 中国已成为全球最大的货物贸易国，与世界各国的经济联系日益紧密。
items.reference: China has become the largest trader of goods in the world, and its economic ties with other countries are becoming increasingly close.
hints: 得分点：最大的 / 货物贸易国 / 经济联系 / 日益紧密
「货物贸易国」可译为 trader of goods；「联系」可用 tie／link
句型：China has become …, and its economic ties with … are becoming increasingly close.

items.zh: 随着居民消费升级，服务业在国民经济中的比重逐年上升。
items.reference: In the national economy, the proportion of the service industry has been rising year by year with the upgrading of household consumption.
hints: 得分点：随着……的升级 / 居民消费 / ……的比重 / 服务业 / 逐年
「升级」可用 upgrading；「比重」是 proportion；「逐年」是 year by year
句型：In the national economy, the proportion of … has been rising year by year with the upgrading of …

items.zh: 中国的互联网经济蓬勃发展，创造了大量的就业机会。
items.reference: China's internet economy is booming and has created a large number of job opportunities.
hints: 得分点：互联网经济 / 蓬勃发展 / 大量的 / 就业机会
「蓬勃发展」可用 boom／flourish；「创造机会」用 create opportunities
句型：China's Internet economy is booming and has created …

items.zh: 政府出台了一系列减税政策，帮助中小企业渡过难关。
items.reference: The government has introduced a series of tax reduction policies to help small and medium-sized enterprises tide over their difficulties.
hints: 得分点：一系列 / 减税 / 中小企业 / 渡过
「出台政策」可用 introduce policies；「中小企业」常说 small and medium-sized enterprises
句型：The government has introduced … to help … tide over …

items.zh: 中国的扶贫事业取得了举世瞩目的成就，数亿人摆脱了贫困。
items.reference: China's poverty alleviation has achieved remarkable results that have attracted worldwide attention, with hundreds of millions of people lifted out of poverty.
hints: 得分点：扶贫／脱贫 / 显著的成就 / 举世瞩目 / 摆脱贫困
「举世瞩目」可用 attract worldwide attention；「摆脱贫困」用 lift sb. out of poverty（被动）
句型：China's poverty alleviation has achieved … that have attracted …, with … lifted out of poverty.

items.zh: 数字经济正在成为推动中国经济高质量发展的新引擎。
items.reference: The digital economy is becoming a new engine driving the high-quality development of China's economy.
hints: 得分点：数字经济 / 新引擎 / 推动 / 高质量发展
「引擎」是 engine；「推动」用现在分词 driving 作后置定语
句型：The digital economy is becoming a new engine driving …

items.zh: 随着劳动力成本的上升，许多企业开始加大技术创新的投入。
items.reference: As labor costs rise, many enterprises have begun to increase their investment in technological innovation.
hints: 得分点：劳动力成本 / 上升 / 加大……的投入 / 技术创新
「随着」可用 as 引导时间状语从句；「加大投入」用 increase one's investment in
句型：As labor costs rise, many enterprises have begun to increase their investment in …

items.zh: 中国的高铁网络不仅方便了人们出行，也带动了沿线城市的经济发展。
items.reference: China's high-speed rail network has not only made travel more convenient, but also boosted the economic development of the cities along the lines.
hints: 得分点：高铁网络 / 不仅 / 也／而且 / 经济发展
「高铁」是 high-speed rail；「带动」可用 boost／drive；「不仅……而且……」用 not only … but also …
句型：China's high-speed rail network has not only made …, but also boosted …

items.zh: 近年来，中国居民越来越重视理财，投资渠道日益丰富。
items.reference: Chinese residents have attached increasing importance to financial management in recent years, and investment channels have become increasingly diversified.
hints: 得分点：近年来 / 越来越重视 / 理财 / 投资渠道
「重视」可用 attach importance to；「理财」可译为 financial management；「渠道」是 channel
句型：Chinese residents have attached … to … in recent years, and investment channels have become …

items.zh: 中国的对外贸易结构不断优化，高附加值产品出口增长迅速。
items.reference: The structure of China's foreign trade has been continuously optimized, and the export of high value-added products has grown rapidly.
hints: 得分点：对外贸易 / 优化 / 高附加值产品 / 增长迅速
「优化」是 optimize，用被动语态；「高附加值的」是 high value-added
句型：The structure of … has been continuously optimized, and the export of … has grown rapidly.

items.zh: 共享经济在中国发展迅速，共享单车和共享充电宝随处可见。
items.reference: The sharing economy has developed rapidly in China, and shared bikes and shared power banks can be seen everywhere.
hints: 得分点：共享经济 / 发展迅速 / 共享单车 / 随处可见
「共享经济」是 the sharing economy；「充电宝」可译 power bank；「随处可见」用被动 can be seen everywhere
句型：The sharing economy has developed rapidly in China, and shared bikes … can be seen everywhere.

items.zh: 旅游业已成为国民经济的重要支柱，带动了交通、餐饮等行业发展。
items.reference: Tourism has become an important pillar of the national economy, driving the development of industries such as transportation and catering.
hints: 得分点：重要的支柱 / 国民经济 / 带动 / ……等行业
「支柱」是 pillar；「带动」用现在分词 driving 作结果状语；「……等」用 such as
句型：Tourism has become an important pillar of …, driving the development of industries such as …

items.zh: 中国正加快推进市场化改革，以促进资源的高效配置。
items.reference: China is accelerating market-oriented reforms to promote the efficient allocation of resources.
hints: 得分点：加快推进 / 市场化改革 / 促进 / 资源的高效配置
「市场化」可用 market-oriented；「配置」是 allocation；「以……」用不定式表目的
句型：China is accelerating … to promote the efficient allocation of resources.
